title: The day-after follow-up reaches every gathering that is due, not just the first 200 events in a four-day band

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), funnels review of #3230 (LIVE-802) and #3231 (LIVE-803).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: the hourly follow-up cron read events starting between now minus about four days and now plus 14 hours, oldest first, capped at the 200-item budget, then filtered for the ones that ended 2 to 26 hours ago. Due events sit near the end of that band, so once it held more than 200 events, older events that were not due filled the page and due ones never got the guest invitation or the 'Did you make it?' email, with nothing reported. THE FIX: the cron pages through the whole band in pages of 1,000 (bounded at 20 pages) and keeps due events up to the budget.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/api/cron/event-followups/route.ts','utf8');if(!/\.range\(page \* PAGE, page \* PAGE \+ PAGE - 1\)/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-826: the follow-up cron reads one capped page of a band where due events sit last');process.exit(1)}"
